integrity: Two distinct deterministic atomic-diagram encodings completely enumerate all 45 canonical factor pairs; their agreement, the exact 19-class table, and the sharp 64-vertex bound are checked by a standalone Python standard-library program. Infinite scope rests on the cited cycle game theorem and a proved coordinatewise product reduction.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to finite unmarked undirected Cartesian products of two cycles in the pure adjacency/equality language at quantifier rank at most four. The bound 64 is optimal only within this family; no independent audit or exhaustive historical novelty certification has been performed.
title: Nineteen rank-four theories of finite torus-grid graphs and a sharp 64-vertex bound
